operations.description: The MEMORY.md stub's example was a literal markdown link to file.md, which never exists -- every fresh install shipped a dangling memory link. Caught by the injection-contract test.

edits.find:
printf '# %s memory

One line per entry: `- [Title](file.md) - hook`
' \
edits.replace:
# No literal markdown link in the template: `[Title](file.md)` names a
            # file that never exists, so every fresh install shipped a dangling
            # pointer -- a memory the agent is told about and cannot follow.
            printf '# %s memory\n\nOne line per entry, linking to a file beside this one.\n' \
